tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description: Search 150+ free Keyframer recipes (bounce, carousels, progress rings, particles, text effects, shaders, scroll animations…). Each recipe has a scene + verified React Native Reanimated code. Returns slugs for get_recipe.

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Fetch one recipe by slug: metadata, the scene JSON (usable as a starting point for create_scene), and the generated React Native Reanimated component code. Recipe code is free to use.

tools.name: get_scene_format
tools.description: The Keyframer scene JSON format — read this before authoring a scene. Section "scene" covers elements/keyframes/easing; section "nodes" covers node graphs (procedural animation: clocks, springs, repeaters) with the full node-type schema.

tools.name: validate_scene
tools.description: Validate a scene against the Keyframer format before create_scene or generate_code. Returns errors (must fix) and warnings (advisory). Free to call — iterate until clean.

tools.name: sample_scene
tools.description: Numerically preview a scene: evaluates keyframes AND node graphs at N evenly spaced times and returns each moving prop as a value series (the same math the editor preview runs). validate_scene checks structure — this checks MOTION: confirm ranges, spring overshoot, stagger offsets, and that elements

tools.name: create_scene
tools.description: Save a scene and get an editor URL where it opens in the visual editor (timeline, canvas, node graphs, mobile QR preview). Validates first. tools.name: update_scene
tools.description: Replace the content of one of your scenes (full scene JSON, validated first) — the edit loop for iterating instead of duplicating. Live previews watching the scene update in place. Requires an API key; own scenes only.

tools.name: list_scenes
tools.description: List the scenes in the connected Keyframer account (id, name, updated, visibility). Requires an API key.

tools.name: get_scene
tools.description: Fetch one of your scenes (or any public scene) as JSON — edit it and re-save with update_scene, or feed it to generate_code. Requires an API key.

tools.name: get_preview_qr
tools.description: A terminal-scannable QR code for a scene. Scan it with a phone camera and the scene runs live in the Keyframer preview app on real hardware — edits sync as they happen. Public scenes (including guest scenes) work without a key; private scenes need an API key on a paid plan.

tools.name: generate_code
tools.description: Compile a scene into a runnable React Native component. Pass inline scene JSON or a scene_id from your account. Output targets Reanimated v4 by default ("animated" targets the RN core Animated API, reduced feature set). Deterministic — no AI, no credits. Requires an API key on a paid plan.
